text:
santosh: Quick run of speculative decoding on redwood-draft-7b vs redwood-13b verify.

santosh: tl;dr: ~3.8x tokens/sec, p50 latency down ~2.6x, but LAMBADA accuracy drops ~1.5% (abs) when draft is int8-quant.

maya: can you paste the run flags?

santosh: sure:
```
./serve_eval --speculative \
  --draft_model=redwood-draft-7b \
  --verify_model=redwood-13b-fp16 \
  --draft_topk=12 --verify_topk=2 \
  --draft_temp=0.7 --verify_temp=0.0 \
  --verify_every=4 --batch=16 --quant=draft-int8
```

ci-bot: job #4821 finished: throughput=3.8x, tokens/sec=11200 -> 42800, p50=78ms->30ms, p95=420ms->200ms, lambada_acc=0.873 -> 0.858

lucy: hmm int8 on draft? did you try fp16 draft? quality diff smaller?

santosh: yes — draft fp16 gives 0.4% drop only, throughput 3.1x. int8 is fastest but accounts for most quality loss.

ben: how reproducible across seeds/det? we should run with deterministic decode to isolate spec artifacts.

maya: can we get the eval harness config? need prompt sets + scoring script.

santosh: eval dir used: evals/spec_ablation/redwood_draft/ — scoring is exact-match for lambada, rouge for summarization set, and token-LL for heldout.

santosh: ablation plan:
- vary draft_topk: [4,8,12,20]
- vary verify_every: [2,4,8]
- draft quant: [fp16,int8,q4]
- verify model: [13b-fp16,13b-8bit]

maya: add a check for KV-cache consistency — speculative can misalign attention caches when using quantized kernels.

lucy: good call. file a quick test: run with `--dump-kv-checks=true` and compare hash snapshots.

santosh: added. also noticed batching interactions: speculative + big batch = tail latency jitter. reducing per-batch max_seq helped.

ben: let's standardize metrics in a spreadsheet: col = config, tokens/sec, p50/p95, lambada_acc, rougeL, rollback_rate.

santosh: created sheet: https://redwood-internal/sheets/spec-decode-ablation (please comment)

maya: tentative next steps: run full grid overnight, collect EM/LL metrics, then pick top 3 configs for human eval.

lucy: +1. also include a few safety/regression prompts to check for hallucination increase.

santosh: thanks all — will kick off grid tonight and post summary tomorrow morning :rocket:

ben: :thumbsup:

maya: nice work. tagging @eng-runtime FYI in case kernel changes needed.
